| description = Zlandicar is one of the final members of the first brood - Veeshan's first offspring on Norrath. During the war against [[Kerafyrm]], he attempted to increase his power by cannibalizing dragons slain by Kerafyrm. For committing this forbidden act, the Claws of Veeshan exiled him. He now resides in the [[Dragon Necropolis]], where he feasts upon the remains of wurms and commands a race of rat creatures known as the [[Chetari]]. He is a suspect in the disappearance of Frakadar. Unconfirmed how he is able to eat food.
 
Slowable.  Rampages.  Stun breath, rotting flesh, dragon roar, putrefy flesh. Doesn't see invis, oddly, despite being undead and a raid boss dragon.

Zlandicar will engage with Paebala+Neb if they are trained to his lair.  Neb and 5 Paebala got him down under 80%.  However, when he kills an NPC, he apparently hits the bug which desynchronizes him from his spawn point, which likely causes him to gate despite being at spawn; after killing Neb and 5 Paebala in this experiment, he gated repeatedly while being killed on his platform during a normal engage.
